parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Who heads what at home

  • Praveen Vashisht (IPS 1991, Bihar cadre) appointed Vigilance Commissioner in the Central Vigilance Commission.
  • Sunetra Pawar became Maharashtra's first woman Deputy Chief Minister, after the death of Ajit Pawar.
  • Praveen Kumar (IPS 1993, West Bengal) – Director General, BSF.
  • Shatrujit Kapoor (IPS 1990) – Director General, ITBP.
  • Rakesh Agarwal (IPS 1994, Himachal) – additional charge of DG, NIA.
  • A.K. Balasubramanian – Chairman, Atomic Energy Regulatory Board, succeeding D.K. Shukla.
  • Air Marshal Nagesh Kapoor – Deputy Chief of the Air Staff, succeeding Air Marshal Narmdeshwar Tiwari.
Central Vigilance Commission: statutory body under the CVC Act, 2003; one Central Vigilance Commissioner and up to two Vigilance Commissioners, appointed by the President; term 4 years or till age 65. Present CVC: P.K. Srivastava.

Indians on global panels

  • Diplomat D.B. Venkatesh Varma named Chair of the UN Secretary-General's Advisory Board on Disarmament Matters for 2026–27.
  • Former Telecom Secretary Aruna Sundararajan is a government nominee on RBI's new Payments Regulatory Board.

Leaders abroad

  • Delcy Rodríguez, Vice President, made acting President of Venezuela by its Supreme Court after Nicolás Maduro was taken to the US.
  • Yoweri Museveni elected President of Uganda for a seventh term.
  • Mamady Doumbouya elected President of Guinea.
  • Foreign Minister Shaya Mohsen al-Zindani became Prime Minister of Yemen after Salem bin Breik resigned.
  • Taliban's Mufti Noor Ahmad Noor took over as acting chargé d'affaires at the Afghan Embassy, New Delhi.
